The API tier stays responsive because document work is asynchronous. Service Bus absorbs enterprise bursts; independently scalable AKS
workers consume at the rate allowed by AI quotas and downstream capacity. Per-business-unit quotas, priorities, cost budgets and
dead-letter handling prevent one workload from starving the enterprise platform.
Every job records model and policy
Load test with real page mix and
1. One shared platform, isolated logically by business unit; authorization, partition keys, storage paths, quotas and chargeback use the same
2. Asynchronous document processing is the default; Service Bus absorbs bursts and independently scalable workers protect the API tier.
3. Human review is a first-class capability with LOB queues, skill/SLA routing and immutable reviewer attribution.
4. Persistent business data stays in Canadian regions. Production use of Content Understanding is gated on Canadian regional availability.
5. Production, non-production, connectivity and security/management are separated into enterprise subscriptions.
